newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia successfully ends spring sowing - minister.
newsitem.headline: Serbia successfully ends spring sowing - minister.

text.p: Serbia has sown 2.15 million hectares to date out of 2.3 million planned for the spring campaign, the agriculture minister said Thursday.
"The government's efforts have helped the spring campaign near completion and we expect planting to be finished in next couple of days," Serbia's agriculture minister Jovan Babovic said.
"This is a big success as it was done regardless of the unfavourable weather conditions," he told a meeting of agricultural co-operatives.
Babovic said some 2.15 million ha was sown in time and was better cultivated than the previous years thanks to government efforts to secure enough semi-finished goods necessary for spring planting.
He said bad weather damaged some 28,000 ha under newly emerged beet plants, but added that some 20,000 ha has been re-sown.
"Only 57 percent of the sugar beet area planned was sown," Babovic said.

Out of the total area planned for spring campaign 100,000 ha was planned to be sown with sugar beet, 200,000 with sunflower, 80,000 with soybean, 255,000 with vegetables, 190,000 with fodder crops and 1.4 million with maize.
But the minister gave no details on acreage of other crops. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 222 4254
